## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT (item_i_product_name) FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE item_i_manufact_id BETWEEN 667 AND 667 + 40 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) AS item_cnt FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE (obt.item_i_manufact = obt.item_i_manufact AND ((obt.item_i_category = 'Women' AND (obt.item_i_color = '1' OR obt.item_i_color = '1') AND (obt.item_i_units = '1' OR obt.item_i_units = '1') AND (obt.item_i_size = '1' OR obt.item_i_size = '1')) OR (obt.item_i_category = 'Women' AND (obt.item_i_color = '1' OR obt.item_i_color = '1') AND (obt.item_i_units = '1' OR obt.item_i_units = '1') AND (obt.item_i_size = '1' OR obt.item_i_size = '1')) OR (obt.item_i_category = 'Men' AND (obt.item_i_color = '1' OR obt.item_i_color = '1') AND (obt.item_i_units = '1' OR obt.item_i_units = '1') AND (obt.item_i_size = '1' OR obt.item_i_size = '1')) OR (obt.item_i_category = 'Men' AND (obt.item_i_color = '1' OR obt.item_i_color = '1') AND (obt.item_i_units = '1' OR obt.item_i_units = '1') AND (obt.item_i_size = '1' OR obt.item_i_size = '1')))) OR (obt.item_i_manufact = obt.item_i_manufact AND ((obt.item_i_category = 'Women' AND (obt.item_i_color = '1' OR obt.item_i_color = '1') AND (obt.item_i_units = '1' OR obt.item_i_units = '1') AND (obt.item_i_size = '1' OR obt.item_i_size = '1')) OR (obt.item_i_category = 'Women' AND (obt.item_i_color = '1' OR obt.item_i_color = '1') AND (obt.item_i_units = '1' OR obt.item_i_units = '1') AND (obt.item_i_size = '1' OR obt.item_i_size = '1')) OR (obt.item_i_category = 'Men' AND (obt.item_i_color = '1' OR obt.item_i_color = '1') AND (obt.item_i_units = '1' OR obt.item_i_units = '1') AND (obt.item_i_size = '1' OR obt.item_i_size = '1')) OR (obt.item_i_category = 'Men' AND (obt.item_i_color = '1' OR obt.item_i_color = '1') AND (obt.item_i_units = '1' OR obt.item_i_units = '1') AND (obt.item_i_size = '1' OR obt.item_i_size = '1'))))) > 0 ORDER BY item_i_product_name LIMIT 100
```
